BASE_FLAG.reason: BASE_FLAG is the base-claim flag: limited to exactly ONE per base and required to claim the base. It is not a design/decoration part.
BASE_FLAG.guidance: Use a non-flag tip (CORNERPOST/S_LARGETRYE0 spike) or SET_CLASS_B beam for roof crowns. Never repeat BASE_FLAG.

retractions.claim: powerlines break |At|=1 with At as a non-unit run vector
retractions.reason: observed only via Blender, whose connector representation is unreliable; not a trustworthy convention. Finding #11 (At=unit, scale=|Up|) stands for RIGID PLACED parts only and is NOT extended to connectors.
